title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Turn-In, Advance Inspection and Wear Assessment
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — turning the vehicle in and the inspection of wear**

**Lease-end options letter.** A lease-end options letter is mailed 120 calendar days before the maturity date.

**Turning the vehicle in.** Turning the vehicle in is the lessee's own act at any Kestrel dealer, who records the odometer statement; the lessee must make that appointment.

**Scheduled end or early termination.** A turn-in counts as a scheduled-end turn-in only when the turn-in date is no earlier than 90 calendar days before the maturity date; an earlier turn-in is an early termination unless it qualifies as a pull-ahead. The turn-in date and the maturity date on the lease record decide.

| Turn-in date (hypothetical maturity December 31) | Days before maturity | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| October 2 | 90 | scheduled-end turn-in |
| October 1 | 91 | early termination, unless it qualifies as a pull-ahead |
| December 31 | 0 | scheduled-end turn-in |

**When the vehicle comes back.** The remaining adjusted lease balance is extinguished; under a closed-end lease the lessee does not owe the residual value.

**Advance inspection.** The lessee may have 1 complimentary advance inspection performed within 90 calendar days before the maturity date. It informs the lessee, but the final inspection at turn-in governs the charges.

**Recording wear items.** A wear item can be recorded only while the lease status is active, maturity extended, returned or early terminated. An item is excess when it exceeds the Kestrel wear standard: dents or scratches at or above the tier's dent and scratch length limit, windshield chips at or above the tier's chip size limit or any chip in the driver's view, any tire below the minimum tread depth or mismatched, a damaged wheel, torn or burned upholstery, a missing key or equipment, or an inoperative light. Each excess item is charged at the wear charge schedule figure for its category; items within the standard carry a charge of $0.00.

**Hypothetical illustration**: a final inspection records a torn seat, a missing second key and a scratch shorter than the scratch limit. The torn seat and the missing key are excess and each is charged at its category's schedule figure; the short scratch is within the standard and carries $0.00.
